- Total revenue reached £32,657.36 TW, representing an 86.6% WoW increase from £17,497.91 LW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER maintained the top position with £2,963.43 TW revenue and a 9.1% share of total sales TW.
- RETRO SPOT TEA SET CERAMIC 11 PC achieved the second-highest revenue at £2,071.74 TW, up 552.6% WoW from the prior week.
- FAWN BLUE HOT WATER BOTTLE generated £1,903.35 TW revenue, capturing 5.8% of total sales TW.
- GLITTER HANGING BUTTERFLY STRING experienced the largest WoW surge, increasing 4752.8% from £23.11 LW to £1,121.49 TW.
- REGENCY CAKESTAND 3 TIER posted the largest WoW decline, falling 55.8% from £3,730.99 LW to £1,647.56 TW.
- WHITE HANGING HEART T-LIGHT HOLDER recorded the most orders at 55 TW compared to 53 LW.
